paper_metadata.title: Tensile Behavior of SiC Fiber-Reinforced γ-TiAl Composites Prepared by Suction Casting

evidence.quote: The process of preparing SiC fiber-reinforced γ-TiAl composites by the conventional methods is difficult and complicated due to the high reactivity, high melting point and poor deformability of γ-TiAl alloys.
The tensile strength of the SiCf/TiAl composites was higher than that of the matrix alloys at both room temperature and 800 °C.
Ti–48Al–2Cr–2Nb (at.%) which had been used in GEnx engine [24] was chosen as the matrix alloy.
A layer of titanium alloy (Ti–5Al–2Sn–2Zr–4Cr–4Mo, at.%) was sprayed on the surface of the fiber by magnetron sputtering.
Tensile tests of the matrix alloy and composites were performed at room temperature and 800 °C.
SiCf/TiAl composite has been successfully prepared by suction casting in this work.
